claims.text: The dataset was constructed to exceed the size and classification specificity of other datasets, with a total of 7,787 questions.
Questions were organized into categories and shuffled randomly to counterbalance learning effects during annotation.
Two annotators, including a lead annotator with professional domain expertise, annotated the entire dataset to ensure quality and consistency.
